text:
sara_support: Heads-up — customer AcmeCorp on iOS (Safari 16.4) sees the dashboard embed in their mobile app with the legend items pushed over the chart area. Tooltips sometimes show the wrong series label. Also they report analytics counts are ~5–7m delayed. Happening for several users, high priority. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.s3/embeds/acme_legend_ios.png :exclamation:

anya_qa: Can you paste quick repro steps? Is this only the embedded iframe or also in main console? Device model/OS? Any console errors?

sara_support: Repro steps from customer:
1) Open app webview (iOS Safari mobile) -> navigate to /app/analytics/embed?org=acme
2) Rotate to portrait if needed
3) Tap legend toggles quickly
Observed: legend overlaps chart area, tapping legend sometimes toggles wrong series tooltip.
They attached console logs and the HAR.

sam_frontend: Thanks. Pushed a quick investigation — I can repro on local Safari iOS simulator with the same embed. Looks like the legend container uses `position: absolute` + flex and a new `transform` introduced in last release that changes stacking context. When scaled down, the legend's calc for left offsets becomes negative and overlaps.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: frontend/analytics v2.13.0 deployed at 2026-03-10T18:02:12Z — changelog: "legend layout refactor, legend virtualization" — rollout: 100% :rocket:

anya_qa: Also, the tooltip mismatch feels like the tooltip hook is mapping indices incorrectly when the legend reorder or virtualization kicks in. Could be an index desync between render and hover handler.

alejandro_metrics: On the metrics delay: we've noticed the metrics-aggregator queue spiked around the same deploy window — job PLAT-987 is processing a backlog; delays ~5–10m currently. Working to drain it, ETA ~30m. This will cause "missing" or delayed points in charts, esp for short time windows.

sara_support: Customer wants a workaround now — can we force the old legend layout for embeds while a fix is prepared? They are on a paid Dedicated plan, requesting urgent patch. Marking P1.

sam_frontend: I can roll a temporary CSS override to disable the transform and force `position: relative` for legend in embeds. Quick patch I can hotfix to staging and then prod if QA green. Patch snippet:

/* temporary fix: disable virtualization in mobile embeds */
.embed-analytics .legend-container {
  position: relative !important;
  transform: none !important;
  left: auto !important;
  right: 0 !important;
  overflow-x: auto;
}

I'll also add a guard so virtualization isn't enabled for iframe embeds (data-embed="true").

jess_engineer: I'll own the prod rollout if QA signs off. Sam, can you open a PR and link the staging URL here? Also please include a small e2e that clicks legend items and verifies tooltip mapping so we don't regress.

sam_frontend: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pull/4829 — includes CSS override + e2e + changelog note. Staging URL: https://staging.redwood.app/app/analytics/embed?org=acme

anya_qa: Testing now on iOS simulator + real device. Quick note: repro requires rotating and fast toggles; I'll validate tooltip mapping test. If it passes, we can ship the hotfix. :white_check_mark:

alejandro_metrics: Update: backlog drained to ~2% — counts should be back to normal within ~12m. Will post when fully cleared.

sara_support: Thanks team — I'll message AcmeCorp with the staging patch + ETA and offer a temporary refresh workaround (clear webview cache). Marking customer update sent.

jess_engineer: Once QA thumbs up, request prod hotfix deployment window (rolling) — I recommend low-traffic immediate window. I'll monitor metrics and error rates. @eng-frontend @eng-runtime FYI.

sara_support: Customer appreciated the quick turnaround. I'll keep thread updated with their confirmation. :thumbsup:

-- end of thread --
